menu_options.cloud: Import once from a Gemstone account, then run locally

cloud.title: Import from Gemstone account
cloud.description: Sign in once to copy a controller's setup (light count, zones, colour order), designs and saved patterns into Home Assistant, and to save Gemstone's official pattern library to the www/gemstones folder. Your password is not stored and the cloud is not used after setup.

data.enable_local: Switch on Allow Local Commands if it is off

data_description.enable_local: Opt in to let this import turn on Allow Local Commands, which exposes unauthenticated HTTP control on your LAN. Without it, LAN control only works if the setting is already on in the Gemstone app.

local.title: Local controller
local.description: Enter the address of a Hub2 with Allow Local Commands already enabled. No Gemstone sign-in is used. Reserve its address in your router.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth controller
bluetooth.description: Enter a provisioned Hub2 Bluetooth address visible to a connectable Home Assistant adapter or proxy. Close the Gemstone app during setup. Firmware 1.1.5 is verified; password-protected firmware and new-device provisioning are not supported. For a controller already in this integration, set its Bluetooth address in the options to keep its entities and content.

controller.title: Choose controller
controller.description: Pick the controller to add. Run the import again to add another.

import_host.title: Controller address
import_host.description: {name} could not be reached at its imported address. Enter its LAN address and make sure Allow Local Commands is on.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Gemstone cloud.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address or hostname without a URL, port, or path.
error.cannot_connect_local: Could not read this controller over LAN. Check its address and enable Allow Local Commands in the Gemstone app.
error.invalid_bluetooth_address: Enter a Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.cannot_connect_bluetooth: Could not read the controller over Bluetooth. Check its address, adapter range and available connection slots, and disconnect the Gemstone app. Password-protected firmware is not supported.
error.cloud_rejected: The Gemstone cloud refused the import. The app identity this integration presents may be outdated; check the log.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.no_new_controllers: Every controller on this account is already configured.
abort.not_configured: This Gemstone controller is not set up in Home Assistant.

connection.title: Controller connection
connection.description: Override the LAN address, or enter a Bluetooth address to use a connectable HA adapter or proxy instead of LAN; clear it to return to LAN. LAN requires Allow Local Commands. Bluetooth releases its connection after each operation.

data.bluetooth_address: Bluetooth address (optional; replaces LAN for the selected controller)

reimport.title: Re-import from Gemstone account
reimport.description: Sign in once to refresh this controller's setup, zones, designs and saved patterns, and the library in www/gemstones. The password is not stored.

cloud.title: Cloud access
cloud.description: Off by default. When on, your Gemstone credentials are stored and the cloud is used when the controller does not answer locally, and for the soft reboot action. Turning it off deletes the stored credentials.

data.cloud_access: Use the Gemstone cloud as a fallback
data.password: Password (leave empty to keep the stored one)

error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address or hostname without a URL, port, or path.
error.select_controller: Select the controller this address belongs to.
error.invalid_bluetooth_address: Enter a Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Gemstone cloud.
error.cloud_rejected: The Gemstone cloud refused the import. The app identity this integration presents may be outdated; check the log.
error.no_matching_controller: This account has no controller matching this entry.

play_library_pattern.name: Play library pattern
play_library_pattern.description: Play a pattern from Gemstone's official library, downloaded once to www/gemstones, by name.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Optional library folder to search within.

play_by_name.name: Play by name
play_by_name.description: Play a saved design or pattern by name, or a library pattern when nothing saved matches. Target several lights to start them together.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name as shown in the Design or Pattern dropdown.

save_content.name: Save local content
save_content.description: Create or replace a pattern, design or zone in Home Assistant. Vendor catalogs are unchanged.

name.name: Name
name.description: Saving the same name replaces the local item.

content.name: Content
content.description: Pattern/design object, or a zone object with inclusive start and end pixel indices (0–4095).

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Optional label for a saved pattern.

delete_content.name: Delete local content
delete_content.description: Delete a local item. An imported vendor item with the same name becomes visible again.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: The type of item to delete.

export_catalog.name: Export catalog
export_catalog.description: Return patterns, designs, zones and downloaded library content for a portable local backup.

import_catalog.name: Import catalog
import_catalog.description: Merge a version 1 export into local storage. Matching names are replaced after the entire input validates.

catalog.name: Catalog
catalog.description: The object returned by Export catalog.

backup_favorites.name: Back up favorites
backup_favorites.description: Save this controller's patterns, designs and zones to a file in gemstone_backups in the config folder.

restore_favorites.name: Restore favorites
restore_favorites.description: Merge a file from gemstone_backups back into this controller's patterns, designs and zones.

file.name: File
file.description: Backup file name. Leave empty for the newest backup of this controller.

save_current.name: Save current content
save_current.description: Save the current pattern, solid color or design to the local catalog.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name for the saved pattern or design.

play_content.name: Play custom content
play_content.description: Play a pattern or design object without saving it. Patterns may target a zone; designs require the whole controller.

content.name: Content
content.description: The pattern or design object to play.

soft_reboot.name: Soft reboot controller
soft_reboot.description: Request a cloud soft reboot. Requires the cloud access option; the controller may be unreachable for about one minute.

controller.name: Controller
controller.description: Select the whole-controller light, even if it is unavailable.
